newsitem.title: USA: Jackpot Enterprises to sell casino.
newsitem.headline: Jackpot Enterprises to sell casino.

text.p: Jackpot Enterprises Inc said it reached a letter of intent to sell one of its two remaining casinos.
It did not disclose the planned buyer or ther terms of the deal, but said it expected to have a definitive agreement by the end of November.
It said the sale will allow it to focus on its core gaming machine business, and other strategic opportunities.

"The increase in gaming machine route operations revenues reflects progress in gaining new accounts and new store openings for existing chain stores," Jackpot president and chief executive officer Don Kornstein said in a statement.
But he also said the company sees a lot of its future growth coming from investments in "attractive, value-oriented non-gaming opportunities."
He added that "while the gaming machine route business generates relatively stable cash flows, it is not a high growth business."
